title: 7.15 Mission: A Day with Friends
unit_outcome: Talk about the body, feelings, clothes, the weather and seasons, free time and invitations, ask people to repeat or speak slowly, and name things outdoors, animals, sports and music in Spanish.
goal: Go to the park with Ana, then answer out loud.
grammar_function: All Spanish A1 patterns, in a mission.
speaking_outcome: Go to the park with Ana, then answer out loud.

cards.prompt: ¿Qué tiempo hace hoy? Hace frío y está lloviendo.

cards.spanish_translation: How is the weather today? It is cold and rainy.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 01/24: Proposal M00. Approved mission beat: Before choosing what to take, Ana asks Luis about today’s weather at home. His answer establishes the cold, rainy outing; both speakers have distinct views.

audio_assets.text: Go to the park with Ana. First, check the weather and get her things ready. Then confirm the bus and the times, ask for the directions again and meet her friends. Finish by answering out loud.
